name: skip-link
title: Skip Link
description: A link to the main content that stays hidden until it takes keyboard focus, then floats at the top start of the viewport above everything else.
docs: Render it first in `<body>`: `<SkipLink>Skip to content</SkipLink>`. The text is required (write it in the page's language). `target` is the element to skip to, an id or a ref, and defaults to `"main"`, which `PageLayout as="main"` provides. Activating the link focuses the target (giving it `tabIndex={-1}` if it can't take focus) and scrolls it into view without changing the URL, so a hash router keeps its route. It is still a real `<a href="#main">` (`#` plus the id; pass `href` for a ref target), which works without JavaScript and for a middle or modified click; it only prevents the default when it could focus the target. See the Sidebar docs for where it goes in an app shell.
